purpose: Small, hand-authored engineering diagnostic for the curated seed corpus; not a representative retrieval benchmark or measured user satisfaction.
annotationMethod: Expected results were written from data/seed-works.json before executing or inspecting retrieval outputs. Work titles identify records, not independently verified quotations or adaptation relationships. Exact metadata checks are separated from subjective imagery judgments and unsupported-language probes.

cases.query: 想找英国庄园里穿祖母绿裙子的那个画面
cases.rationale: Paraphrases the stored British estate and emerald dress description.

cases.query: 想找雨夜里没有说出口的告别
cases.rationale: No seed record explicitly satisfies all details. 对倒 supports rain and restraint; 长日将尽 supports unsaid feelings and farewell but no rain. These are partial candidates only, not an exact answer or an objective pass/fail label.

cases.query: 她在小樽的雪地里对着雪山呼喊
cases.rationale: Near-paraphrase of the stored movie description.

cases.query: 没有寄出的信，潮湿草地上的青春和死亡
cases.rationale: The quote and keywords directly mention the unsent letter, wet grass, youth, and death.

cases.query: 我想找茶水和小蛋糕让人突然想起往事的文字
cases.rationale: Paraphrases the stored text using its tea, cake, and past-memory evidence.

cases.query: 一个把一生献给职责却没能说出感情的英国管家
cases.rationale: Combines explicit duty, unspoken feelings, and British butler evidence.
No seed record discusses quantum computing, superconductors, or chips.

cases.query: 如何训练目标检测模型
cases.rationale: No seed record discusses machine-learning training or object detection.
A single overlapping colour character is not evidence for a noodle recipe.
小王子 has stars, flying, and a fairy-tale universe, but no spacecraft battle. Broad atmosphere should not stand in for absent requested content.

情书 explicitly depicts snow. 昨日的世界 is a weaker acceptable candidate because its keywords include 雪山. 安娜 explicitly depicts a snowy train and violates the exclusion. This probes exclusion handling, not just similarity.

cases.query: 英国庄园里黄昏的管家
cases.rationale: The record supports estate, dusk, and butler together; another estate alone is insufficient.
No single seed record supports both a snowy setting and an emerald dress. A product may show clearly labelled partial suggestions, but the repository currently has no partial-match contract.

cases.query: 不要雪，只想找海港的悲伤
cases.rationale: The harbour and sadness evidence is explicit. Exclude records explicitly tagged or described with snow. This only checks absence of snow evidence in the supplied text, not unseen actual film frames.

cases.query: 法国的茶与蛋糕，不要香槟派对
cases.rationale: French tea-and-cake memory matches 追忆似水年华; champagne-party evidence explicitly violates the negative clause.
